cohort: 366 nulliparous women with congenital heart disease and a singleton pregnancy
finding: Women with congenital heart disease are at increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, with higher risk associated with Fontan circulation, anticoagulant use, forceps delivery, emergency Cesarean section, general anesthesia, and higher CARPREG scores.
mod_finding: Women who had a forceps delivery, emergency Cesarean section, or general anesthesia had higher blood loss than those having a spontaneous vaginal birth under regional analgesia.
